1. Topic - This paper addresses seam-induced defects and their structural and mechanical influence in 3D printed thin-walled structures and metamaterials.

5. Takeaway - The paper emphasizes the critical role of seam placement as a printing parameter for thin-walled objects and metamaterials, suggesting that defects can be transformed into strategic design elements to control fracture.
